module comparator (
    input  logic [3:0] a,
    input  logic [3:0] b,
    output logic       eq,
    output logic       gt,
    output logic       lt
);
    always_comb begin
        if (a == b) begin
            eq = 1'b1; gt = 1'b0; lt = 1'b0;
        end else if (a > b) begin
            eq = 1'b0; gt = 1'b1; lt = 1'b0;
        end else begin
            eq = 1'b0; gt = 1'b0; lt = 1'b1;
        end
    end
endmodule

module signed_cmp (
    input  logic signed [3:0] a,
    input  logic signed [3:0] b,
    output logic              gt,  // a > b
    output logic              eq,  // a == b
    output logic              lt   // a < b
);
    always_comb begin
        if (a > b) begin
            gt = 1'b1; eq = 1'b0; lt = 1'b0;
        end else if (a == b) begin
            gt = 1'b0; eq = 1'b1; lt = 1'b0;
        end else begin
            gt = 1'b0; eq = 1'b0; lt = 1'b1;
        end
    end
endmodule

module signmag_to_twos (
    input  logic [3:0] a, // a[3] = sign bit, a[2:0] = magnitude
    output logic [3:0] y
);
    always_comb begin
        if (a[3] == 1'b0)
            y = {1'b0, a[2:0]};       // positive: unchanged
        else
            y = ~{1'b0, a[2:0]} + 4'd1; // negative: negate magnitude
    end
endmodule

module half_select (
    input  logic [7:0] a,
    input  logic       sel,
    output logic [3:0] y
);
    always_comb begin
        if (sel == 1'b0)
            y = a[3:0];  // lower nibble
        else
            y = a[7:4];  // upper nibble
    end
endmodule

module parity_redirect (
    input  logic [3:0] a,
    input  logic [3:0] b,
    output logic [3:0] y
);
    always_comb begin
        if (^a == 1'b0)    // even parity: route a
            y = a;
        else if (^b == 1'b0) // even parity: route b
            y = b;
        else
            y = 4'bxxxx;   // both odd parity: undefined
    end
endmodule

module alt_mask (
    input  logic [3:0] a,
    input  logic       sel,
    output logic [3:0] y
);
    always_comb begin
        if (sel == 1'b0)
            y = a & 4'b1010; // keep bits 3 and 1
        else
            y = a & 4'b0101; // keep bits 2 and 0
    end
endmodule
